content_sections.heading: Collectorate Beed Job Description
content_sections.text: As per Section 6 and 8 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, the appointed Non-Official Members of the District Consumer Protection Council are tasked with the following key responsibilities: Protecting and promoting the rights of consumers within Beed district. Assisting the administration in spreading consumer awareness, consumer education, and consumer rights campaigns. Reviewing and highlighting local issues relating to adulteration, substandard goods, fraudulent practices, and distribution of essential commodities. Participating in council meetings to deliberate on consumer grievances and suggesting redressal measures to the district administration.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Collectorate Beed Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Collectorate Beed Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 vacancies: 2 Municipal Council Member, 2 Agricultural Produce Market Committee Member, 10 Consumer Organization Member, 2 School/College Member, 2 Medical Professional Member, 2 Trade and Industry Member and 2 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Collectorate Beed Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Appendix A of the notification) and send it to Local Tahsildar Office, by by hand, to reach by 29 November 2026.

faq.answer: Anyone convicted in a case relating to misconduct. Anyone who has misappropriated public property. Applicants connected with an organisation or activity banned by the Government. Political, governmental, communal, proprietary or profit-making organisations.

faq.answer: Application scrutiny by District Level Committee. Selection based on eligibility and norms. Appointment order by District Collector. Scrutiny of applications by District Level Committee headed by District Collector.
